title: Design System: Tech Support Skills Reports

extensions.elevation: Flat; tonal grouping and thin rules; no shadows.

theme.screen: System prefers-color-scheme; fixed blue conclusion retains paired foregrounds.
theme.print: Light paper; conclusion becomes dark text on white with horizontal rules; navigation hidden.

extensions.tableBehavior: Horizontal wrapper overflow; visible scroll guidance at mobile breakpoint; wrapper overflow visible in print.
extensions.fontDistribution: Embedded Barlow Condensed Bold and Atkinson Hyperlegible Regular; retain bundled OFL notices.

narrative.northStar: Inherited website identity in report reading mode
narrative.overview: One continuous evidence-first document. Condensed headings name the investigation; readable body text separates observed evidence from qualified interpretation. Blue gives the conclusion prominence and soft tint marks next actions.
rules: Written labels carry evidentiary status; color supplements them.
Adapt sections to the investigation; preserve semantic distinctions.
Preserve readable evidence and limitations on mobile.
dos: Retain font licenses and embedded assets.
Keep confidence reasons adjacent to conclusions.
Keep native links and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Do not impose a fixed measurement schema.
Do not hide limitations or substitute zero for unknown readings.
Do not add runtime interactions or external assets.
